supersession.reason: Version 1 bound the scientific hypothesis but did not operationally bind horizons, target identity, first-vintage custody, append-only settlement, overlap counting, or external timestamp requirements. It is preserved unchanged and retired before any eligible future observation.

freeze.freeze_basis: Operational custody contract frozen before the first version 2 source snapshot, prediction seal, settlement, score, or external anchor.

candidate.description: Hurst-conditioned weighted multiscale increment heuristic using lags 1, 2, 4, and 8 with a bounded persistence multiplier.

sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

request_contract.realtime_start_rule: provider-reported first available ALFRED vintage, rechecked against the bound series value each cycle, then advanced in non-overlapping fixed windows
request_contract.realtime_end_rule: Each historical window ends after 1460 calendar dates; the final recent window uses FRED real-time max date 9999-12-31 to avoid local/provider date skew while remaining under the 2000-vintage JSON limit.

polling_contract.missed_poll_settlement_policy: Provider-authenticated output_type=4 initial-release values may settle a prediction after a missed poll only when the prediction seal predates first_vintage_date under the conservative UTC-boundary rule; no later value may replace that initial release.
polling_contract.eligible_release_order_rule: sealed_at_utc must be strictly before 00:00 UTC on first_vintage_date; this conservative rule does not infer an intraday release time

target_contract.target_selection_rule: For horizon h, select the h-th new observation period strictly after the sealed origin period.
target_contract.revision_policy: Only output_type=4 initial-release values enter primary settlement. Revisions may be appended in a separate sensitivity ledger and never replace primary actuals.

polling_contract.eligible_release_order_rule: sealed exchange-local calendar date must be strictly before the target bar exchange-local session date; same-date seals are invalid even if the provider has not yet published the bar

target_contract.target_selection_rule: For horizon h, select the h-th new exchange daily bar strictly after the sealed origin bar.
target_contract.adjustment_policy: Twelve Data time_series adjust=splits daily close; daily periods are exchange-local and the provider metadata must report America/New_York
target_contract.revision_policy: The first retained post-close provider response is primary. Later changed values append as revisions and never replace primary actuals.

forecast_contract.issuance_rule: One immutable forecast envelope per source, series, observed origin period, and horizon whenever a new complete snapshot becomes the latest origin.

algorithm_parameter_contract.authoritative_binding: The model artifact SHA-256 is authoritative; these fields are a human-readable audit map and must agree with that artifact.

ledger_contract.external_anchor_policy: A local chain is collection custody only. Primary confirmatory scoring remains ineligible until each pre-release terminal hash has a verified independent timestamp or immutable external inclusion receipt.

analysis_contract.contrast_construction: Candidate versus each of eight baselines separately within FRED and TWELVE_DATA source arms.
analysis_contract.overlap_policy: Overlapping origins remain preserved. Inference synchronizes resampling by unique target period within source-series and never treats overlapping forecast rows as independent.
analysis_contract.cell_weighting: equal weight across eligible source-series-horizon cells after each cell aggregates unique targets
analysis_contract.missing_target_rule: Retain as missing and ineligible; no silent row compression or backfill.

decision_rule.replicated_lead: A source winner must repeat under the unchanged protocol in a second independently anchored prospective period before any bounded promotion claim.
decision_rule.source_winner: The candidate must beat all eight source baselines after familywise correction, clear the five percent effect floor, have no source-series-horizon cell worse by more than five percent, and keep the p95 error ratio at or below 1.10.
decision_rule.cross_source_promotion: A source winner must repeat in a second independent prospective period.

claim_boundary: A future complete pass would support only bounded prospective forecasting accuracy for the named sources, series, horizons, first-vintage rules, and periods. Local seals without an independently verified external timestamp remain non-confirmatory. Nothing here establishes trading alpha, field performance, realized savings, enterprise value, universal superiority, government approval, or deployment authority.
